profile.headline: Software Engineer @ ECS
profile.summary: I am a diligent and detail-oriented Software Engineer. My passion for solving problems and programming has shaped my dream to pursue a career in Software Engineering. I am constantly looking for ways to learn more and help create innovative and positively impactful products for users.

positions.title: Software Developer & IT Specialist
positions.description:
● Full-stack development for web applications using Vue.js framework and AWS Amplify backend integration
● Responsible for identifying and fixing bugs in the code. Use debugging tools and utilize Cypress automated testing to ensure that the application works as expected
● Responsible for managing users, devices, and applications in Azure AD
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Cognito · Azure Active Directory · Amazon S3 · CSS · HTML · JavaScript

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
● Received the Outstanding Undergraduate Teaching Assistant Award in May 2022
● Fall 2022 - Teaching assistant for User Interface Design and Development graduate course
● Spring 2022 - Teaching assistant for Software Testing and Maintenance undergraduate course
● Act as a liaison for students and provide mentoring students in related course work
● Regulate and maintain online discussion forum for students

positions.title: Hostess
positions.description:
● Greet and check in guests as they enter the restaurant
● Leading guests to their tables and providing menus.
● Handling phone calls and making reservations.

positions.title: Sales Advisor
positions.description:
● Merchandising duties and providing customer service in the store.
● Arrange garments attractively on racks and shelves, locate merchandise for shoppers, ring up customer purchases, and operate cash registers.

positions.title: Lead Instructor
positions.description:
● Assisted in tutoring math for children ranging from varying levels between 3rd grade to 12th grade as well as establishing a set curriculum for enhancing the learning experience of students.
● Performed general maintenance and office work such as assisting in all paperwork in the center along with addressing concerns and inquiries from parents.
● Hosted educational events and served as a representative for the learning center.

honors.title: Outstanding Undergraduate Teaching Assistant Award
honors.description: Received recognition for the quality of work I did as an undergraduate teaching assistant.
honors.issuer: Issued by Department of Computer Science, School of Computing  College of Engineering and Computing - George Mason University · May 2022
